name: SKYDAO
rootCause: sell-path controller burns the pair's SKYDAO and syncs before the net sell is credited, latching a near-zero reserve that a direct pair.swap drains for the pair's entire USDT. Lost: 59,914.12 USDT net to the attacker (exactly reproduced) on BNB Chain; the SKYDAO/USDT PancakeSwap V2 pair lost its entire 183,482.88 USDT reserve, drained by a direct pair.swap against the reserve the sell-path burn+sync latched to ~0
